about: Big account upgrades, tiered from community consensus (Theoatrix's untradeables and goals guides, the wiki's Ironman guide, a dozen progression guides, the wiki reward-shop pages) on 2 Nov 2026. Reddit was unreachable, so the tiers are a synthesis, not vote counts. Costs are wiki numbers; GE prices are rough and dated. Images are the wiki's, loaded live.

tiers.S: Every account, as early as it can
tiers.A: Big step up once you qualify
tiers.B: Worth it when it fits what you're doing

items.name: Fairy rings
items.how: Play Fairytale II until the Fairy Godfather lets you use the rings. You don't finish the quest. Needs a dramen or lunar staff in hand.
items.why: Teleports to almost everywhere. The single most-named unlock in every guide. Lumbridge elite diary drops the staff requirement.

items.name: Spirit trees
items.how: Finish Tree Gnome Village. More trees unlock with The Grand Tree and later quests.
items.why: Second teleport network that fills the gaps fairy rings leave. Gnome Stronghold, Khazard, Varrock GE, Prifddinas later.

items.name: Ardougne cloak 1 to 4
items.how: Easy Ardougne diary for cloak 1. Each tier adds teleports and stats.
items.why: Cloak 1 is unlimited teleports to the monastery altar next to a fairy ring and bank. Cloak 4 is the best prayer bonus in the cape slot.

items.name: Ectophial
items.how: Finish Ghosts Ahoy.
items.why: One-click teleport to the Ectofuntus, next to a herb patch, for every farm run.

items.name: Royal seed pod
items.how: Finish Monkey Madness II.
items.why: Unlimited one-click teleport to the Grand Tree that works up to level 30 Wilderness.

items.name: Book of the dead
items.how: Finish A Kingdom Divided.
items.why: Every Kourend teleport in one book plus a prayer bonus, and it unlocks the Arceuus resurrection spells.

items.name: Graceful outfit
items.how: 260 marks of grace from rooftop courses, bought from Grace in the Rogues' Den.
items.why: Run energy comes back 30% faster and you weigh 25 kg less. Partial sets give almost nothing, go for the full six.

items.name: Barrows gloves
items.how: Finish all of Recipe for Disaster, then buy them from the Culinaromancer's chest.
items.why: +12 to every melee style and ranged, +12 strength. The best gloves until Ferocious, and every guide's number one mid-game goal.

items.name: Dragon defender
items.how: Warriors' Guild. Earn tokens, work up through the defenders, then cyclopes in the basement drop it at 1 in 100.
items.why: +25 attack and +6 strength in the shield slot for nothing. Later it becomes the Avernic defender.

items.name: Fire cape
items.how: Beat the Fight Caves, 63 waves ending with TzTok-Jad. Pray against his attacks by watching his animation.
items.cost: Free, about an hour per attempt
items.why: Best melee cape until the Inferno, +4 strength and +2 prayer. Also the moment most players learn prayer switching.

items.name: Ava's accumulator and assembler
items.how: Animal Magnetism gives the attractor (30 Ranged) and accumulator (50 Ranged). After Dragon Slayer II, take Vorkath's head and the accumulator to Ava for the assembler.
items.why: Picks your ammo back up (72%, 80% for the assembler) and the only ranged cape worth wearing before the quiver.

items.name: Slayer helmet (i)
items.how: Unlock Malevolent Masquerade for 400 slayer points, craft it from a black mask plus the slayer headgear at 55 Crafting, then imbue it.
items.cost: 400 slayer points, black mask, 1,250,000 NMZ points or 500 Soul Wars zeal (half after hard combat achievements)
items.why: +16.67% melee and +15% ranged and magic on task. Slayer is how most accounts train, so this is a permanent damage boost.

items.name: Rune pouch
items.how: 750 slayer points, or 75 Last Man Standing points, or buy the note on the GE.
items.why: Three rune types in one slot, 16,000 of each. Frees two inventory spaces on every trip that uses magic.

items.name: Void Knight armour
items.how: Pest Control. Helm 200, top 250, robe 250, gloves 150 commendations. Elite upgrade is 400 more for top and robe.
items.cost: About 850 points per style, 1,250 for elite
items.why: Ranged void is +10% accuracy and damage (12.5% elite), stacks with the salve. The ranged set is the one guides call almost vital.

items.name: Salve amulet (ei)
items.how: Haunted Mine for the amulet. Lair of Tarn Razorlor to enchant it. Imbue at NMZ, Soul Wars or with a scroll of imbuing.
items.why: +20% accuracy and damage in every style against undead. Doesn't stack with the slayer helm but does with void.

items.name: Imbued god cape
items.how: Mage Arena (kill Kolodion's four forms) for the god cape, then Mage Arena II in the deep Wilderness to imbue it.
items.why: Best magic cape by a mile: +15 magic attack and +2% magic damage. Needed to get the most out of any staff.

items.name: Fighter torso
items.how: Barbarian Assault: 375 honour points in each of the four roles plus one Penance Queen kill.
items.why: Same +4 strength as a Bandos chestplate for nothing. Also ticks a hard Kandarin diary task.

items.name: Arclight
items.how: Shadow of the Storm for Darklight, then 3 ancient shards from the Catacombs of Kourend on the altar.
items.why: +70% accuracy and damage against demons. Beats a tentacle whip on every demon task.

items.name: Dwarf multicannon
items.how: Finish Dwarf Cannon, then buy the four parts from Nulodion.
items.why: Doubles the speed of most slayer tasks and trains ranged on the side. Every slayer guide treats it as essential.

items.name: Herb sack
items.how: 750 slayer points or 250 Tithe Farm points.
items.why: 30 of every grimy herb in one slot. Turns herb-dropping tasks and farm runs into bank-free trips.

items.name: Seed box
items.how: 250 Tithe Farm points.
items.why: Six seed types in one slot. Saves five spaces on seed-heavy tasks and every farm run.

items.name: Coal bag
items.how: 100 golden nuggets at Motherlode Mine.
items.why: 27 coal in one slot. The thing that makes Blast Furnace steel, mithril, adamant and rune worth doing.

items.name: Gem bag
items.how: 100 golden nuggets at Motherlode Mine.
items.why: 60 of each uncut gem, filled automatically while mining. Useful on gem rocks and most slayer tasks.

items.name: Plank sack
items.how: 350 carpenter points from Mahogany Homes.
items.why: 28 extra planks per trip. Halves the bank trips of every Construction method, and it's the main reason to do Mahogany Homes.

items.name: Looting bag
items.how: 10 slayer points, or a drop from Wilderness monsters.
items.why: 28 extra slots, Wilderness only. Essential for Wilderness slayer and bosses, useless elsewhere.

items.name: Colossal pouch
items.how: Buy the abyssal needle for 750 abyssal pearls at Guardians of the Rift and use it on your essence pouches.
items.why: All four essence pouches become one. Runecrafting trips carry 40 more essence.

items.name: Divine rune pouch
items.how: Thread of Elidinis from Tombs of Amascut on a rune pouch.
items.why: A fourth rune slot. Lovely for raids, nothing before them.

items.name: Bonecrusher
items.how: Hard Morytania diary, then claim it from the ghost disciple at the Ectofuntus.
items.why: Buries every bone your kills drop for half XP, full with the elite. Thousands of free prayer levels over an account.

items.name: Ash sanctifier
items.how: Hard Kourend and Kebos diary, from Tyss.
items.why: Same idea for demon ashes. Free prayer XP on every demon task.

items.name: Kandarin headgear 3
items.how: Hard Kandarin diary.
items.why: Seers' Village rooftop teleport goes to the course start, Camelot teleport to Seers' bank. The fastest Agility from 60 to 90 lives here.

items.name: Karamja gloves 3
items.how: Hard Karamja diary.
items.why: Free Duradel teleports and the underground gem mine. Makes him a slayer master you can actually use.

items.name: Explorer's ring 4
items.how: Elite Lumbridge and Draynor diary.
items.why: Fairy rings with no staff, 30 alchs a day, and a sixth slayer block slot. The elite tier is the one that matters.

items.name: Varrock armour 2
items.how: Medium Varrock diary.
items.why: Varrock teleport can land at the Grand Exchange, and 30 battlestaves a day from Zaff. The cheapest big daily.

items.name: Piety
items.how: 70 Prayer and 70 Defence, finish King's Ransom and the Knight Waves training ground.
items.cost: Prayer XP, roughly 70 to 150m to 70 at a gilded altar
items.why: +23% strength, +20% attack, +25% defence. The biggest single melee multiplier you can own.

items.name: Protection prayers
items.how: 43 Prayer. Bury big bones, or bones at a gilded altar.
items.why: Blocks melee, ranged or magic damage outright. Nothing else in the game saves as many deaths.

items.name: Rigour and Augury
items.how: 74 Prayer with a dexterous prayer scroll, 77 with an arcane one. Both drop from Chambers of Xeric or sell on the GE.
items.why: Piety for ranged and magic. Rigour is +23% ranged damage. Cheap now compared to the gear it multiplies.

items.name: Ancient Magicks
items.how: Finish Desert Treasure I.
items.cost: Quest items, a few hundred thousand gp
items.why: Bursts, barrages, freezes and blood spells. Unlocks the fastest magic training, bursting slayer tasks, and most PvM later.

items.name: Lunar spellbook
items.how: Finish Lunar Diplomacy, then Dream Mentor for the rest of the book.
items.why: Vengeance, NPC Contact, Spellbook Swap, Fertile Soil, Humidify. The support book every skiller and bosser ends up on.

items.name: Ornate rejuvenation pool
items.how: 90 Construction (82 with crystal saw and spicy stew). Build up from the restoration pool at 65.
items.why: Full heal, prayer, run, special attack and cures, every time you go home. The house becomes your base after this.

items.name: Ornate jewellery box
items.how: 81 Construction for the basic box, 83 for ornate.
items.why: Unlimited glory, ring of dueling, games necklace, skills necklace, combat bracelet and ring of wealth teleports from one object.

items.name: Portal nexus
items.how: 72 Construction for the nexus, 92 for the crystalline one that holds everything.
items.cost: Thousands of runes per destination, tens of millions for all 31
items.why: Every teleport spell in the game, no runes, from your house. Pair it with the pool and you never need a bank between trips.

items.name: Occult altar
items.how: 90 Construction. Needs the ancient, lunar and Arceuus signets plus a pile of runes.
items.cost: About 4.5m upgrading an ancient altar, 13m from scratch
items.why: Swap between all four spellbooks at home. Without it you're walking to altars or wearing the magic cape.

items.name: Crystal saw
items.how: Finish The Eyes of Glouphrie.
items.why: Invisible +3 Construction that stacks with stew. Every big house build gets cheaper by three levels.

items.name: Magic secateurs
items.how: Finish Fairytale I.
items.why: 10% more herbs from every patch, forever. The best free item for anyone doing herb runs, which is everyone.

items.name: Prospector kit
items.how: 180 golden nuggets at Motherlode Mine.
items.why: 2.5% Mining XP and the helmet is a hard Falador task. You get it while you're already there.

items.name: Lumberjack outfit
items.how: Temple Trekking, from undead lumberjacks.
items.why: 2.5% Woodcutting XP, and the full set is a master clue step.

items.name: Pyromancer outfit
items.how: Wintertodt supply crates.
items.why: 2.5% Firemaking XP. You'll have it by 99 without trying.

items.name: Farmer's outfit
items.how: 400 Tithe Farm points for the set.
items.why: 2.5% Farming XP, a tiny lift on tree and herb runs. Get the seed box and herb sack from the same shop first.

items.name: Rogue outfit
items.how: Rogues' Den safe-cracking minigame.
items.why: Double loot from every pickpocket with the full set. Doubles Thieving gp for the rest of the account.

items.name: Raiments of the eye
items.how: 1,350 abyssal pearls across the four pieces at Guardians of the Rift.
items.why: 60% more runes with the full set. Runecrafting profit and GOTR points both climb.

items.name: Dragon scimitar
items.how: Finish Monkey Madness I, buy it in Zanaris or Ape Atoll.
items.why: The main melee weapon from 60 to 70 Attack and the first one that feels fast.

items.name: Abyssal whip
items.how: GE, or a 1 in 512 drop from abyssal demons at 85 Slayer.
items.why: Fast, accurate and cheap. Carries slayer from 70 Attack to the raids weapons.

items.name: Toxic blowpipe
items.how: GE, or a tanzanite fang from Zulrah after Regicide.
items.why: The fastest weapon in the game. Zulrah, Vorkath, most slayer tasks, the gauntlet. Still the mid-game ranged weapon.

items.name: Amulet of fury
items.how: GE, from onyx.
items.why: +10 to everything. One amulet for all three styles until Torture, Anguish and Occult.

items.name: Occult necklace
items.how: GE, or a drop from smoke devils at 93 Slayer.
items.why: +5% magic damage for a few hundred thousand. The best damage per gp in the game.

items.name: Dragon boots
items.how: GE, or spiritual mages at 83 Slayer.
items.why: +4 strength in the boot slot for pocket change. Becomes primordials later.

items.name: Helm of Neitiznot
items.how: Finish The Fremennik Isles, buy it from Mawnis Burowgar.
items.why: +3 strength and +3 prayer with real defence. The melee helmet from 55 Defence until the faceguard.

items.name: Berserker ring (i)
items.how: Dagannoth Rex drop or GE, then 650,000 NMZ points or 260 zeal to imbue.
items.why: +8 strength in the ring slot. The imbue doubles it, which is why NMZ points matter.

items.name: Fossil Island
items.how: The Dig Site, 100 kudos at the Varrock Museum, then Bone Voyage.
items.why: Birdhouse runs (the best passive Hunter XP), ammonite crabs, the herbiboar, hardwood patches and Volcanic Mine.

items.name: Prifddinas
items.how: Finish Song of the Elves.
items.why: The Gauntlet and the bow of faerdhinen, Zalcano, the best crafting and thieving spots, a teleport crystal. The biggest late unlock.

items.name: Morytania
items.how: Finish Priest in Peril. A Taste of Hope later gives Drakan's medallion for teleports.
items.why: Barrows, the Slayer Tower, Canifis rooftops and the Ectofuntus. Half the early game sits behind one short quest.

items.name: Quest point cape
items.how: Every quest.
items.why: Unlimited teleport to the Legends' Guild, which has a fairy ring, and the proof you've unlocked everything above.

items.name: Kharedst's memoirs
items.how: Finish Client of Kourend. Each Kourend quest adds a page.
items.why: Teleports around Kourend early. Replaced by the book of the dead later.

items.name: Slayer ring (eternal)
items.how: Unlock Ring Bling for 150 slayer points, then craft the eternal ring from an eternal gem.
items.cost: 150 slayer points, eternal gem from superiors
items.why: Unlimited teleports to the slayer caves and straight to Nieve. Cuts the dead time between tasks.

items.name: Holy wrench
items.how: Finish Rum Deal.
items.why: Every prayer potion restores a little more. Small, but it never stops paying once your Prayer is 70+.

items.name: Chugging barrel
items.how: Mastering Mixology reward shop.
items.why: Drinks five potions in one click. A raids item, nothing before them.

items.name: Expeditious and slaughter bracelets
items.how: Enchant an opal bracelet (expeditious) or a jade one (slaughter). Cheap on the GE.
items.why: Expeditious skips kills on tasks you hate, slaughter adds kills to the ones you love. Free slayer XP either way.
